follow-up time: Until first calving, and up to 50 days after first calving
outcome: Culling risk within 50 days after first calving
cohort: 35,128 Holstein-Friesian heifers from 33 large commercial dairy herds in Hungary, first inseminated between January 1, 2011 and December 31, 2014
finding: Heifer reproductive performance, including age at conception, age at first calving, and calving difficulty, was significantly associated with survival to first calving, first-lactation milk yield, and culling risk.
mod_finding: Heifers that required caesarean section were 24.01-times more likely to leave the herd within 50 days after first calving compared to heifers that needed no assistance.
